text:
(11) Where the accused has given a statement of the kind mentioned in section 6B(4), then,
for the purposes of subsections (2)(f)(ii) and (iv), the question as to whether there
has been a breach of the requirements imposed by or under section 6A or a failure to
comply with section 6A(2)(a) or (b) shall be determined—
(a) by reference to the state of affairs at the time when that statement was given,
and
(b) as if the defence statement was given at the same time as that statement.
Criminal Procedure and Investigations Act 1996 (c. 25)
